title: Tanker report - Week 46
summary:
Clean
LR2
The TC1 75kt MEG/Japan index ultimately ticked up by 8 points this week to WS1016, while the corresponding Baltic round-trip TCE edged up by $3,061 to $298,000/day. For the TC20 90kt MEG/UK-Continent run, the index rose by $264,000 to $19.23 million, corresponding to $297,300/day on Baltic round trip. The TC15 80kt Mediterranean/East index shed a further $820,000 to settle at $7.9 million, with the Baltic round-trip TCE falling by $10,100 to $63,400/day.

children.title: VLCC
children.summary: VLCC rates on the Baltic Exchange routes headed downwards again this week. The TD3C route (270,000 mt Middle East Gulf/China) has fallen 188 points since last Friday to WS1014.38, producing a daily round-trip TCE of $1,078,714 for the standard Baltic VLCC.

children.title: Suezmax
children.summary: In the Suezmax sector, the market has fallen again this week across all the Baltic Exchange routes. The rate for the 130,000 mt Nigeria/UK Continent voyage (TD20) fell by 92 points to WS307.22, giving a daily round-trip TCE of about $151,300.

children.title: Aframax
children.summary: In the North Sea, the rate for the 80,000 mt Cross-UK Continent route (TD7) fell 78 points to WS247.5, giving a daily round-trip TCE of just below $141,300 basis Hound Point/Wilhelmshaven. In the Mediterranean, the rate for the 80,000 mt Cross-Mediterranean route (TD19) fell by 15 points to WS267.78.
